driver: A quantity averaged over a window is assembled from a complete record of one part of a population and periodic counts of all of it taken only outside the window; the unrecorded part is not a fixed multiple of the recorded part, and the counts outside the window also catch members present only near the counting times, so scaling the record by the counts' ratio, or adding the counts' mean unrecorded number, misstates the window, and only the unrecorded members counted on both sides of the window, with no record of their own inside it, give the window's unrecorded part.
driver_concrete: Each zone's weekday noon-to-2 occupancy joins two app vendors' minute-by-minute record of paid vehicles to the enforcement routes' plate reads of every parked vehicle, which in the neighbourhood districts come only mid-morning and mid-afternoon; there the unpaid vehicles at midday are disability placard holders parked all day, while the morning run also catches residents' overnight cars and the afternoon run school-run stops, so the window's unpaid vehicles are the plates read unpaid on both runs either side of it.
stump: The default path adds each zone's mean unpaid count on its enforcement runs to the complete paid record, a model downtown's in-window 12:30 run confirms, and raises Alder Row, Cascade Avenue and Hollis Street (95, 95 and 91 per cent) and holds Fernwood and Irvine Market (71 and 71); the neighbourhood runs come only mid-morning and mid-afternoon, when the unpaid vehicles include residents' overnight cars and school-run stops, so only the vehicles read unpaid on both the last run before noon and the first after 2 p.m. were parked through the window, which holds the three at 79 per cent and lowers the two at 55 and 53.

differentiation.task107: task107's ETL architecture lost the months a payment feed never recorded and the scheme counts as nil; task458 v2 recovers which unpaid vehicles were parked through a window no read covers, from each vehicle's own reads on both sides of it, against a paid record that is complete.
differentiation.task458: architecture 1 counted members with a condition from claims censored by enrollment, each identified member over its own window's sensitivity measured on the full-year members; architecture 2 has no sensitivity, no reference group and no completion factor: the paid vehicles are recorded in full, and the unpaid vehicles in the window are the ones read on both of a day's passes, the rest of the passes' unpaid reads being people present only near the pass times.
differentiation.task473: task473 completes a count by one over a catch rate at each case's level of the trait, measured where every unit is tested; task458 v2 completes nothing by a rate: the window's unpaid vehicles are counted directly from their own reads on both sides of the window, and the trap is a ratio or a mean taken at the wrong times.
differentiation.task275: task275 rebuilds unobserved trips from a catch per hour of effort by ground; task458 v2 has no effort and no observer effect: the plate reads see every parked vehicle at their times, and the error is carrying the reads' unpaid mix at those times into a window they do not cover.
differentiation.task120: task120 subtracts a storage gain between midnights from production; task458 v2 has no storage and no balance: it adds to a complete paid record the unpaid stock present through the window, identified by reads on both sides of it.

lineage.fate: solved at stage 4 by the isolated leak reader (Sonnet, medium) at loop 0: the full-year prevalence standardized by eligibility group was a reflex once the group mix showed, so the stump was re-centred on the seasonal members' own records
lineage.driver: A population defined by a lasting trait is counted from records that show the trait only through events logged while each unit is observed; the rate is measured on the fully observed units, but full observation depends on a grouping that also drives the trait, so the fully observed units' rate has to be taken within each group and carried to each group's units, and carrying it whole overstates exactly the segments whose units come and go.

lineage.niche: a nonprofit Medicaid health plan's designation of eastern Washington counties for a 2027 behavioral-health prescriber loan-repayment pilot, each county scored on prescribers per adult member with a serious mental illness, per adult member with an opioid use disorder, and the share of members with a serious mental illness seen by a prescriber, populations the claims record only through services billed while a member is enrolled
lineage.driver: A population defined by a lasting trait is counted from records that show the trait only through events logged while each unit is observed; the fully observed units cannot stand in for the briefly observed, because staying observed is selected on the trait, so each recorded unit is counted as one over the share of fully observed trait-holders recorded within a window of its own length, measured on their time to a first event, and carrying the fully observed units' rate to every unit, even within the visible groups, overstates exactly the segments whose units come and go.
lineage.driver_concrete: Adult members with a serious mental illness or an opioid use disorder appear in the claims only through services billed while they were enrolled; the members enrolled all year are fully observed but are not a sample of the membership, because the farmworkers who enrol for a harvest have the conditions about half as often, so each identified member is counted as 1 over the share of the full-year members with the condition identified within the same number of months, and carrying the full-year prevalence to every member, eligibility group by group, overstates Yakima and fails it on two standards it meets (figures fixed at build).
lineage.stump: A strong analyst completes each county's members with each condition, as NP-31 2.5 requires, with the prevalence its members enrolled all year show within each eligibility group, carried to all the group's members, and designates Adams, Douglas, Franklin, Grant, Okanogan and Yakima, because the seasonal expansion adults and parents in Yakima's short spells have the conditions about half as often as the members who stay enrolled; counted for the months each identified member was enrolled, Yakima meets all three standards. A weaker analyst counts the identified members and designates Douglas and Okanogan.
